thread:
olivia: Heads-up — tiny docs + version bump I want to sneak into the cut. small change, docs only but touches the release notes file. can we get an exception?

sam: Which file and PR? if it's docs-only we usually allow it in the grace window but need a thumbs from release lead. link the PR pls. :eyes:

olivia: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7821 — updates changelog entry for 1.14.0 and adjusts the upgrade note. no code, just markdown and a version constant in docs config.

raj: quick check — does it modify any codegen or CI matrix? last time a docs tweak unintentionally changed a generated TOC job.

olivia: nope, only /docs/release/1.14.0.md and docs/_config.yml where the version string lives. I ran the local build (`make docs-build`) and it renders fine.

nina: pinging @release-bot for exception flow. we have 1.14 cutoff in ~45m, right?

release-bot: CUTOVER window starts at 2834014300. Reminder: last safe merge is 2834011600 (30m before cut). Exceptions require two approvals: release lead + eng-shepherd.

sam: ok, @olivia can you add a short changelog blurb in the PR body and include a rollback plan? release lead wants a 1-liner and that it’s trivial to revert.

olivia: done — PR body updated with revert steps and the exact git commands. posting here:```
# revert steps
git checkout main
git revert --no-commit 7821
git commit -m "revert: docs bump for 1.14.0"
git push origin main
```

raj: CI shows a flaky docs rendering job but it's green now. CI run id: 7821.3. I re-ran if the release team wants a fresh green. @ci-bot can you queue one?

ci-bot: queued rerun for PR #7821. Status: queued -> running -> success :white_check_mark:

nina: release lead is OOO but i'm covering. i can approve the exception if release criteria met: docs-only, revertable, CI green, no dependent changes. I approve. :thumbsup:

sam: i can act as eng-shepherd. quick look — LGTM from me. approving the exception.

olivia: thanks both. tagging note — please stamp the PR with `release/approved` label so the merge bot picks it up.

release-bot: exception recorded: ID exc-2026-03-17-01, approved_by: nina,sam, merge window expiry: 2834011600. Mergebot will allow merge with label `release/approved` until cutoff.

olivia: merging now via mergebot. merging command:```
hub am --merge
```

release-bot: Merge recorded. PR #7821 merged by mergebot at 2834010502. Congratulations, docs bump included. Please notify product for release notes sanity check.

sam: nice. small reminder for next time: put the short revert command in the PR title too, makes it faster during cutovers.

olivia: noted. thanks all. :relieved:
